description: Partial request-pattern mitigation. Rejects parent-directory markers on Grafana plugin asset routes.
affected_versions: grafana grafana: >= 8.0.0, < 8.0.7, >= 8.1.0, < 8.1.8, >= 8.2.0, < 8.2.7, = 8.3.0; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Rejects parent-directory markers on Grafana plugin asset routes.
limitations: Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Literal traversal-like plugin asset names are denied.
